name: Zhejiang Leapmotor Technology Co., Ltd.
blurb: Zhejiang Leapmotor Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer specializing in affordable smart EVs. The company designs and produces a range of electric cars, including sedans and SUVs, leveraging in-house developed technologies. Leapmotor has gained market traction in China's competitive EV sector and is expanding its product lineup.
recent: Over the past 30 days, Leapmotor's stock declined about 9.8%, though it saw a 2% gain on the most recent trading day. The company continues to attract investor attention amid valuation assessments and mixed short-term returns.
